card.name: Start of OATP transporter names
card.fires_on: The letter O that begins OATP or OAT transporter names (OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OAT2) in drug interaction lists. It usually follows P-gp, BCRP and a comma or "and".

modes.label: After BCRP in a list
modes.description: The O of OATP1B1 comes right after P-gp, BCRP and a comma, "and" or "or".
modes.example: TAF, a component of GENVOYA, is a substrate of P-gp, BCRP,<< O>>ATP1B1 and OAT

modes.label: Other transporter lists
modes.description: The O of OATP or OAT comes after "substrate of" or a slash-separated list of transporters.
modes.example: Voxilaprevir is also a substrate of<< O>>ATP1B1 and OAT

card.plain: It marks the start of the transporter name OATP in drug interaction lists.
